Main issues i observed were sir


1) Wide range of  Infections ranging from post dialysis fever to severe infections like infective endocarditis, spondylodiscitis, Central line sepsis

6) Erythropoietin and iron sucrose given once in every 15 days or one month maximum.

7) Ckd and  Bicarbonate therapy in itself a huge issue

5/23/22, 12:29 PM - Kims Aditya Samitinjay: Clinical Complexity - Preliminary Problem List.docx (file attached) and pasted below :


Case 1 - https://poreddyjahnavi128.blogspot.com/2021/12/general-medicine.html


  1. Individual level – What is the cause of CKD in this young man ? What are the factors which inhibited a full and thorough work-up of all his problems ?

  2. Family level – Why did the patient stop medication due to a distressing event in his familial life ? What are the factors that led to this and what can be done ?

  3. Community level – What role did the community have in his disease process ?

  4. Ecosystem/Medical system level – What are the prevalent factors which led to ESRD in a young patient ? How did the medical fraternity fail in providing care to this patient ?

Case 2 - https://saisurya100.blogspot.com/2021/10/32-yr-old-man-with-ckd-on-mhd-with.html


  1. Individual level – What is the cause of CKD in this young man ? What are the factors which inhibited a full and thorough work-up of all his problems ?

  2. Family level – What role did the family have on his disease process? What effect did the patient’s problems have on his family ?

  3. Community level – What role did the community have in his disease process ?

  4. Ecosystem/Medical system level – What are the prevalent factors which led to ESRD in a young patient ? How did the medical fraternity fail in providing care to this patient ?

Case 3 - https://saichennuru.blogspot.com/2021/09/45-year-old-male-patient-with-back-pain.html


  1. Individual level – What is the cause of CKD in this young man ? Why did this patient develop diabetes at a young age ?

  2. Family level – What role did the family have on his disease process? What effect did the patient’s problems have on his family ?

  3. Community level – What factors in the community precipitated diabetes and CKD in this patient ?

  4. Ecosystem/Medical system level – What can be done to improve access to primary, secondary, and tertiary health care at the ecosystem level ?

Case 4 - https://nikhithapulipeta130.blogspot.com/2022/02/50ym-follow-up-case.html


  1. Individual level – What is the cause of CKD in this young man ? Why did this patient develop diabetes at a young age ?

  2. Family level – What role did the family have on his disease process? What effect did the patient’s problems have on his family ?

  3. Community level – What factors in the community precipitated diabetes and CKD in this patient ?

  4. Ecosystem/Medical system level – What can be done to improve access to primary, secondary, and tertiary health care at the ecosystem level ?


Common questions to all patients

  1. 4 young to middle aged men – Common theme – Fairly active lifestyle and then biochemically found to have kidney injury, drastic change in life with sudden initiation of dialysis (or even MHD) in all of them.

  2. All 4 went on to develop osteopathologies. What factors at the levels mentioned above may have contributed to these ?

  3. At each level, how was institution of care impeded ? What factors can we modify and what are beyond our control ?
